title: Clarifications on keys, preconditioning, and feature behavior
summary: This topic is dominated by factual clarifications about vehicle functions and access features, with only one clearly positive mention about preconditioning comfort.

positive.summary: The only positive review praises preconditioning for keeping the cabin comfortable.

undetermined.summary: Most reviews are explanatory clarifications about keys, locking behavior, seats, drive mode behavior, preconditioning, dealership responsibility, and paddle shifting without clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: The cluster mixes several unrelated clarification topics, including preconditioning, key access, locking behavior, seats, drive mode behavior, dealership referral, and paddle shifting.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined rather than evaluative, so the examples provide limited evidence about customer satisfaction with these features.
